# Universal AI Directives & Autonomous Dispatch Protocol

All AI coding tools (Claude Code, Cursor, Gemini, Copilot, Codex, Aider, etc.) MUST strictly follow the repository constitution defined in [AGENTS.md](./AGENTS.md).

## ⚡ Autonomous Persona & Skill Dispatch Protocol
When receiving any user prompt or instruction:
1. **Autonomous Persona Adoption**: Even if the user does NOT explicitly name a role, evaluate the prompt intent against the 12 Universal Personas in [AGENTS.md](./AGENTS.md) and adopt the best matching persona.
2. **Autonomous Skill Execution**: Identify and load relevant skills from `.agents/skills/` (e.g., `strict-unit-tester`, `api-contract-builder`, `secops-guard`, etc.) without requiring explicit user invocation.
3. **Execution Transparency**: Declare the assumed persona and skills at the beginning of the response (`[🎭 Persona: <name> | 🧩 Skills: <skills>]`), and adhere strictly to TRUST 5 quality gates and @intent provenance comments.
4. **Mandatory Multi-Agent Delegation**: For any non-trivial coding task (feature implementation, bug fixes, refactoring), the primary AI MUST adopt the `manager-lead` persona, invoke the `agent-delegator` skill, decompose the task, delegate implementation to `manager-develop`, and require independent verification from `trust-auditor` prior to completion.
